newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Trepca metalworks invests $5 mln in overhaul-paper.
newsitem.headline: Trepca metalworks invests $5 mln in overhaul-paper.

text.p: Yugoslavia's metal works Rudarsko Metalurski Kombinat Trepca has invested nearly five million dollars in an overhaul of its facilities, Belgrade daily Politika wrote on Tuesday.
The plant was closed down in August to undergo an overhaul, the first in fifteen years, after which it is expected to double its output.
Trepca's main furnace was shut down after sixteen months of constant work. It produced 40,000 tonnes of crude lead in that period.
After August 28, when the overhaul is completed, the furnace will double production to a monthly 7,000 tonnes of lead from the current 3,000, said director of lead metallurgy plant Novica Bastarevic.
The Trepca group is based in Serbia's southern Kosovo province and includes 14 lead and zinc mines, two metallurgy plants and 14 factories.
